description: Java class implementing an Akka actor named ConciergeForwarderActor, which forwards signals to different components based on their EntityId and type, primarily used within a concierge service context in an Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConciergeForwarderActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for forwarding signals to either the concierge enforcer or dispatcher, depending on whether the signal contains a valid entity ID; used as part of a concierge service infrastructure within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for the ConciergeForwarderActor with optional signal transformer; used to instantiate the actor with specified references.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, including forwarding signals and handling subscription acknowledgments.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Routes the incoming signal to either the pub-sub mediator or the concierge enforcer based on whether the signal has an associated entity ID.
